title: SNCC - (Skyrimnet Cinematic Camera)
description:
SNCC – SkyrimNet Cinematic Camera Compatibility
SNCC is a simple compatibility patch that allows Cinematic Conversation Camera (CCC) to work with SkyrimNet conversations.
Normally, Cinematic Conversation Camera does not recognize SkyrimNet's AI-generated conversations as traditional Skyrim dialogue.
SNCC bridges that gap, allowing you to activate CCC's cinematic camera during SkyrimNet conversations using a hotkey.
Features
Adds compatibility between Cinematic Conversation Camera (CCC) and SkyrimNet.
Allows CCC's cinematic camera to be used during SkyrimNet conversations.
F8 – Toggle the cinematic camera on or off.
F9 – Cycle through available camera angles.
Supports CCC's cinematic camera functionality, including cinematic black bars.
Requirements
Skyrim Special Edition
SKSE
SkyrimNet
Cinematic Conversation Camera (CCC)
Note: SNCC does not replace Cinematic Conversation Camera. It simply extends its functionality to support SkyrimNet conversations.
